submit_steps: 1 Create an account Sign-up is at /user/sign-in/signup, not /register or /signup, which both 404. It is a plain Yii form: username, email, password twice, no captcha at this stage. The username becomes your public byline.
2 Paste the URL Step one at /story/submit is a single URL field. It validates live, then their scraper pulls your page title and meta description.
3 Fix what the scraper wrote Step two pre-fills the title and content from your page. Rewrite both: their guidelines ask you to explain what the thing is and why it is worth a look.
4 Choose a category It defaults to "all", which is not a real category. There are 16 real ones including SEO, Web, Software, Business and Tech.

rejection_reasons: Duplicate submissions of a URL someone already posted
gotchas: Sign-up lives at /user/sign-in/signup. The obvious paths (/register, /signup, /user/register) all 404, which makes the site look closed to new members.
An image captcha guards the final submit, so this one always needs a human at the keyboard no matter how much of the form is automated.
Their scraper pulled our page title with a double-escaped & in it, which would have published as literal "&" in the headline. Always read the pre-filled title before submitting.
The category select defaults to "all", which is not a real category and buries the story. Pick one of the 16 real ones.
It says "submitted for Review" but the story is live on /story/all within a minute, so treat the wording as boilerplate rather than a queue.
The page still advertises a bookmarklet for "OnDashboard.com", leftover white-label text, so this is one of a family of cloned Yii bookmarking sites rather than a bespoke community.
